craft_notes: Sthāyin: great dissolution count. Rows: number then name. Read aloud: dread sum.

lines: In the Lord's time hundredfold, the count thereof: the Blest day, that long the night; that alone the Great Unmaking.
l4.sanskrit_cite: aiśvare kāle parārdhaśataguṇite yā saṃkhyā tat sādāśivaṃ dinaṃ tāvatī niśā sa eva mahāpralayaḥ
